description: This source file defines functions for resolving and managing test plans for different code extensions, including handling directories, counting test files, creating test shards, and merging test plans. It interacts with file system modules, path utilities, and external project-specific configuration helpers.

methods.name: normalizeRelative
methods.description: Normalizes a file path to use forward slashes for relative paths.

methods.name: countTestFiles
methods.description: Recursively counts the number of test files (with extensions .test.ts or .test.tsx) within a directory.

methods.name: resolveExtensionDirectory
methods.description: Determines the directory path of an extension based on a target argument or current working directory, considering project structure.

methods.name: resolveExtensionTestPlan
methods.description: Generates a test plan object for a specific extension, identifying configs, test files count, and roots.

methods.name: mergeTestPlans
methods.description: Combines multiple test plans into grouped summaries based on configuration and other attributes.

methods.name: resolveExtensionBatchPlan
methods.description: Creates a comprehensive plan for multiple extensions, aggregating their test plans.

methods.name: pickLeastLoadedShard
methods.description: Selects the shard with the least load based on test file count and plan numbers.

methods.name: createExtensionTestShards
methods.description: Divides test plans into shards for parallel execution, balancing load across shards.
